narrative: An advanced persistent threat actor targets a large enterprise network, leveraging sophisticated techniques to infiltrate the environment and exfiltrate sensitive data over an extended period.

attack_stages.description: The attacker gathers information about the target organization to identify potential vulnerabilities.
The attacker uses phishing emails to gain initial access to the network.
Malicious software is executed on the compromised systems to establish control.
The attacker establishes persistence on the compromised systems to maintain access.

narrative: An advanced persistent threat actor targets an enterprise network through sophisticated reconnaissance and social engineering tactics to deploy ransomware.

attack_stages.description: The attacker surveys the network to identify vulnerabilities and potential entry points.
The attacker gains initial access to the network through phishing emails containing malicious attachments.
The attacker executes the ransomware payload on compromised systems.
The ransomware encrypts files across the network and demands a ransom for decryption.

narrative: An advanced persistent threat actor targets a cloud infrastructure environment, utilizing various techniques to gain access and maintain persistence.

attack_stages.description: The attacker gathers information about the target cloud infrastructure, including identifying exposed services and potential vulnerabilities.
The attacker gains initial access to the cloud environment through a phishing attack targeting employees.
The attacker attempts to obtain valid credentials to escalate privileges within the cloud environment.
The attacker establishes persistence by creating backdoors within the cloud services.

narrative: An attacker targets healthcare employees through a sophisticated phishing campaign that mimics internal communications, aiming to gain access to sensitive patient data.

attack_stages.description: The attacker gathers information about the target healthcare organization, focusing on employee roles and email patterns.
The attacker delivers a phishing email to employees, tricking them into clicking a malicious link.
Upon clicking the link, the employee is directed to a fake login page, where credentials are harvested.
The attacker uses the stolen credentials to access the healthcare system and exfiltrate sensitive data.

narrative: An attacker sends a phishing email masquerading as a legitimate healthcare provider, attempting to gain access to sensitive patient data.

attack_stages.description: The attacker gathers information about the healthcare organization and its employees to craft a convincing phishing email.
The attacker sends a phishing email that tricks a healthcare employee into providing their credentials.
The attacker uses the obtained credentials to access the healthcare system.
The attacker exfiltrates sensitive patient data from the healthcare system.

techniques.technique_name: Exfiltration Over Command and Control Channel
